rationale: Post-hoc review of an applied service-restoration migration (2026-07-29 ruling: review here is after the fact by design). Migration 558 restores tool-generator save_tool's adopt_existing_page=true, which migration 435 (bugs_open/286, live since 2026-08-16) set and an UN-SNAPSHOTTED write removed between 516's apply (~16:55Z 2026-08-21) and 08:36:05Z 2026-08-22 — no agent_definitions_backup row, no schema_migrations row, writer unidentified. While absent, every adopt-route add_tool fleet-wide died at save_tool with pages_site_id_name_key 23505 and the work item read complete with error NULL; measured casualty one item (21ab0704, tool-blueprint-compiler, the first adopt build attempted after the window opened). The binary was probed (positive + negative control) and still carries the adopt path, so config restore was the whole fix; the refiled build then adopted cleanly and is serve-graded live. The restore was applied before this submission because the lane's Phase C programme (and any other lane's tool rebuild) was dead while the key was absent — the 336 precedent: restore service, then review. REVISE ROUND 2 ANSWERS (2026-08-22, measurements not code — the migration is applied and behaviourally proven): (1) debug_historian's two-active-row hazard: tool-generator has EXACTLY ONE active non-snapshot row (version 1) as of 2026-08-22 — measured, query in grounded_in; and in a hypothetical two-row world this migration's shape ABORTS loudly rather than writing the wrong row silently: the pre-guard demands exactly one key-less matching row (n=2 raises) and the post-guard demands exactly one row carrying true while the unpinned UPDATE would have set both (n=2 raises). The executed transaction printed UPDATE 1 and both guards passed. (2) The behavioural arm pins the LOADED row: the refiled build (item 4d1d56b5) adopted cleanly minutes after the apply — the running loader read the restored key. (3) editquality's version discriminator + doc_notes subject_type: the applied doc_note with subject_type='pipeline' EXISTS (count=1, the CHECK constraint admitted it — the same pair 435 used on 2026-08-16); and the migration FILE now carries a council-sourced template warning telling the next author to pin version, so the copy-as-template propagation path (the 537-copied-526 class) is closed without altering any executed statement.
